profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is listed in the record as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website associated with the company in that record is rolls-royce.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Rolls-Royce, not Richtech Robotics. Rolls-Royce describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for power needs, and says it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. It says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The site material also covers a completed $1 Billion investment in Indiana, a stated strategic intent with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, co-operation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and multiple contractual commitments for Rolls-Royce SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The held record shows no litigation cases, no tracked products and no MCP servers for this company. The site content does not mention Richtech Robotics.
